architecture: Existing WeightSlots/catalog/immutable WeightBatch owners plus original Graph InputSource frontier. Shared cold metadata helper; native resource/transfer remains backend-owned. No new executor, model allowlist, cache/eviction policy, implicit converter or full-global-bank allocation.
assembly: WeightSlice id names local destination bank, not global expert. All dense plain same-dtype canonical host fragments preflight for exact nonoverlapping complete coverage, scalar alignment, capacity and fragment bound. Bank-only alignment leaves packed source bytes unchanged. Host readiness belongs to caller; successful synchronous staging allows original source buffers to be released.
binding: Native span<graph::WeightBinding> resolves all views and immutable owners before one atomic original InputAccess commit. Failed last binding preserves all old bindings and preparation, including first attempted immutable-source attachment. One batch owns W/SF/[WG/IG or Z]/global-local map together. Global ID->local slot uses original checked Gather before original grouped consumer.

geometry.global_bank_not_allocated: NVFP4 W4GiB plus SF512MiB only computed as a size illustration; actual allocations are two bounded four-expert slots. Finite generated source bytes with real role geometry, not publisher payload.

cold_zero_pack: pack_int4_zero_rows explicitly concatenates independently padded I32 low-nibble-first rows into one tight flat EN grid, ignoring poisoned source padding and zeroing output padding. Handles odd rows and strided sources, validates geometry/capacity/canonical aliases before writing, returns flush/close errors. No implicit quantization or zero+1 transform.
accounting: WeightUploadReport distinguishes validated logical payload, complete successful host-read prefix, accepted native copy extent including inter-bank padding and successful retirement. Pending/failure/copied_bytes_unknown never proves zero traffic. Failed partial host read witnesses logical8/staged4/submitted0/completed0/unknown=true; second read may have copied2 unknown bytes.

regression.GPU_scope: Each backend3 new cases: NVFP4 geometry, CT odd-row packed original Decode->Reshape->GroupedMatMul, invalid map/global IDs plus truthful partial staging. Vulkan5 original WeightBinding neighbors and Apple1. All fresh wrappers with current WeightSlotOptions. CUDA new cases require/assert actual captured replay.
regression.lifetime: Two slots/three generations, nonidentity changing local selections and duplicate global IDs. Same-batch grouped binding; host sources released after staging. Old GraphOutput and independent storage_lease remain exact across newer generations and invocation destruction. Reuse rejected while batch/Invocation owns old selection; invalid IDs fail Completion and do not publish; fresh consumers recover.
regression.numerics: Independent literal NVFP4/BF16 boundary oracle and full K CT F32 dot initialized+0, bitwise expected outputs. CT source-padding poison demonstrates naive byte concatenation is not equivalent. No tolerance loosening or expected-failure skips.

Native CUDA/Metal/Vulkan staging reads exact tensor-described subview, accepting legal logical4/storage8 views rather than demanding exact allocation capacity.
Native report observations preserve unknown partial failed staging rather than letting an older completed upload clear it.

closure.reuse: Targeted product/wrapper owners only, existing dependency caches and original CUDA/SPIRV/Metal operator programs reused. No SDK/shader/NVCC/full build. Broad package8 and3delivery packages remain open.

limitations: Selected finite resource composition, no whole-artifact/publisher payload, full model, Linux, quality, latency or throughput claim.
Generic byte bridge now exists; exact MLX mixed MoE/head-bank, PB_WO and other codec/source-role consumers remain distinct work. No automatic equivalence between padded/encoded layouts.

No native GPU device fault/cancellation injection in this batch. Intentional partial host-read and index/domain Completion failures are actual tested faults; accounting is not measured DRAM/bus traffic.
